04 / A little reassurance

Good questions.
Clear answers.

A few things to know before your visit.

I feel nervous about visiting the dentist.+

You’re welcome to share how you feel when arranging your visit. Let the team know what makes you uncomfortable so you can discuss how to take things at a pace that works for you.

What should I bring to my first visit?+

Bring any relevant dental records, a list of your current medications, and the questions you’d like to ask. Confirm any other requirements with the practice when booking.

How do I know which treatment I need?+

Start with a consultation. The dentist can assess your needs, explain suitable options, and discuss a plan with you before you decide.

Can I discuss costs before treatment?+

Yes. Ask for an explanation of the proposed treatment and its costs before proceeding. Fees depend on the individual care you need.
